id.description: Base ID for the accordion. Items without their own id get this base plus the item's index.

items.description: An array of accordion items. Each item sets title and content, and may set id (used for the heading and content ids) and expanded (start open).

multiselectable.description: Whether multiple accordion items can be expanded at the same time.

headingLevel.description: Heading element wrapping each item's button. Choose the level that fits the surrounding page outline.

iconPosition.description: Position of the expand/collapse icon. Omit to use the global USWDS or theme setting.

className.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the accordion.

headingClassName.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the accordion heading.

contentClassName.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the accordion content.
